verdicts.decision_note: The client requires technical review of the electrical change; the provisional Event correctly excludes the delivery deadline and budget.
The client limits the review to the minor electrical modifications identified in the Word file and highlighted material rather than all 36 drawing pages; the price is correctly excluded.
The client defines the PDF as the pre-change reference and the Word-file revisions as the material to review and approve for amendment of the as-built drawings.
The client establishes site photographs as review evidence for checking that completed electrical work matches the Word-file specifications.
